title: Canonical proper forget-supports isomorphism on unbounded etale categories
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with a chosen compactification $X\xrightarrow{i}\overline X\xrightarrow{g}Y$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. On the ordinary unbounded small-etale derived categories of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], define the canonical isomorphism $Rf_!\simeq Rf_*$ by applying the forget-supports isomorphism for extension by zero along i [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], then the derived direct-image composition isomorphism and the identification $gi=f$. Properness makes the open immersion i also closed, so its forget-supports comparison is invertible. This is the ModuleCat(Lambda) specialization of the existing source-library rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar; it imposes no boundedness or Noetherian hypothesis.
